label: Token transfer tax
summary: Model a disclosed token-level transfer tax with explicit scope, exemptions, accounting and pool compatibility evidence.
requiredFacts: Exact tax rate, maximum rate, taxed transfer classes and rounding direction
Exempt actors and paths, who can change exemptions, and whether behavior is immutable
Gross amount, net amount, recipient liabilities and every destination of taxed value
PoolManager, router, liquidity, claim and wallet behavior when actual received value differs from requested value
Public disclosures that distinguish token transfer tax from LP fee, platform share and project hook fee
requiredTests: Taxed and exempt transfer matrix across zero, minimum, ordinary and maximum amounts
Buy, sell, direct transfer, liquidity, claim and router behavior for gross and net amounts
Rate and exemption authority boundaries including renouncement or immutability claims
No hidden confiscation, transfer blocking, balance inflation or recipient insolvency
Pool settlement fails safely or remains exactly solvent when token balance deltas differ
risks: Fee-on-transfer accounting can break pool settlement, routers, liquidity operations and integrations
Mutable rates or exemptions can create honeypot, bypass, favoritism or undisclosed control
Gross-versus-net confusion can overcharge users or make liabilities insolvent
